Mum: Which lesson did you like best?
Sam: Science. I thought I would prefer art, but the demonstration was awesome.
Mum: Did you use the equipment?
Sam: No, we watched the teacher from behind a line.
Mum: What did you bring?
Sam: A notebook. I wrote two questions.
Mum: Were you with Jo?
Sam: No, I worked with Ben, the new pupil.
Mum: What did you learn in IT?
Sam: To keep passwords private. I must not share mine with friends.
